messages.subject: Global Mining Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Joss,

Your work leading mining and mining-services executive search at Omera Partners makes this a focused introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, external affairs, strategic partnerships and executive stakeholder coordination.

I am internationally mobile and open to Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates across mining, natural resources and energy transition, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE as priority markets.

My executive CV is attached for consideration for suitable current or upcoming assignments.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
ragunauthramsaroop.com
